string.text: Hello. It feels pretty empty around here.
People used to hold out here. Now they have scattered: some left, others perished. That is why it is so empty.
Is there any work around here so I can earn enough to eat?
Talk to Trapper about that. He may have hunting work for you. I can sell you essential supplies or send you stash coordinates. There are few people left, and none of them want to check my leads.
Give me the coordinates of a green stash. 500 RU.
I need a blue stash marker. 3,000 RU.
Sell me the coordinates of a purple stash. 8,500 RU.
Done. The marker is already in your PDA. Anything else?
Do you have any more coordinates for today?
No. Five tips per day is my limit. Come back tomorrow.
Not right now. I will not charge you for stale or empty coordinates.
Looks like I cannot afford any of them.
Save up and come back. The prices are fixed.
